summary: Implemented the endpoint-resolver builtin helper. Changes: botocore/regions.py adds EndpointResolverBuiltins (str, Enum) with the eleven members; botocore/args.py adds compute_endpoint_resolver_builtin_defaults to ClientArgsCreator and makes the STS predicate accept a None endpoint config; tests/unit/test_args.py adds TestEndpointResolverBuiltins. tests/unit/test_args.py passes (56 tests). The full unit suite has 11 failures (test_awsrequest.py and test_session*.py), and all 11 also fail on the unmodified code, so they are pre-existing. Not run: black and isort, since black is not in the shared venv; long lines were wrapped by hand. Nothing committed.
